reviews.title: Quality Screen Display
reviews.comment: The product arrived in a timely manner. As a matter of fact it arrived earlier than expected. I loved the way it fits my laptop. I had difficulty installing. Prior to ordering I did not realize I needed 2 HDMI Ports because the connecting cords provided with the monitors had USB connections and I assumed it would work with just the USB connectors. I do not remember reading about the need of HDMI needed. I had to a splitter to make both screens function appropriately with my lap top screen.
reviews.author: NicoleB
